sharedFileOwnership.rule: Every plan's writePaths are disjoint from every other plan's, and sharedPaths is empty for all plans. Only gdp-p01 may run go get, go mod tidy or go mod vendor, or edit go/go.mod, go/go.sum, go/vendor, mise.toml and .gitignore. Other plans that need a module or tooling change write a Reconciliation request. Workers never edit this manifest, impl-plans/README.md, design-docs/**, src/**, db/**, tests/e2e/harness.py, the contract schemas, pyproject.toml or uv.lock, and never run git checkout, restore, stash, reset, clean, commit, add or push. Per-edit discipline: read the file fresh before each edit, record pre/post SHA-256 under the evidence root, and file a Reconciliation request instead of overwriting a file whose hash changed outside the worker's own edits.
sharedFileOwnership.dependencies: The only Go dependency is golang.org/x/text, pinned and vendored by gdp-p01. No Python dependency or lockfile change.
sharedFileOwnership.reconciliation: A defect in another plan's file is a Reconciliation request in the reporting plan's Progress Log, reproduced by a failing test id. Serial finalization reproduces it and fixes the root cause in the owning plan's paths.

reviewContext.userProblem: Telescreen has a Python Google Drive collector (src/telescreen/collectors/google/). The owner wants an optional Go version that covers the same Drive estate (gdrive files, Google Docs exported as text, Google Sheets values) and reports the same data (masked findings, complete_locators, resource_exposures 1.1, resource_inventories 1.2). Because the Bureau never imports out-of-process code, it must integrate as a pull-mode Police worker through contract v1.2.
requiredOutcomes: go/ is a buildable Go module; mise run go-build produces telescreen-gdrive-police; mise run go-test passes with coverage of the contract client, auth, Drive/Sheets clients, exposure, locators/fingerprints, rule detection/masking and the detect/partition/scan_shard handlers.

Golden parity fixtures generated from Python pass in Go: exposure visibility and external principal counts, locators, item and external fingerprints, and rule detection rule_id/rule_class/spans and masked snippets.
A Python contract test validates Go-produced manifest, claim, heartbeat and result envelopes (1.0, 1.1, 1.2, partition and scan_shard) against src/telescreen/contracts/police/v1 schemas.

An offline E2E runs the Go binary against an in-process Bureau with fake Drive/Sheets/Admin/token servers, completes a partition plus scan_shard sweep, and the Bureau accepts the results: findings recorded, exposures and inventories applied, no raw_value_detected.
mise.toml pins go 1.27.3 and mise run ci runs go-lint, go-test and go-build with the Python gates, and is green.
The design doc, go/README.md and examples/police/gdrive-go/README.md describe configuration, enrollment, scaling, and the parity guarantees and limits (rule detector only).
nonGoals: ML and LLM detectors, verify_remediation, push mode.
The Drive changes feed and watch channels (D6).
Any change to the Python collector, the Police contract schemas, the Bureau, the Python SDK or the database schema.
constraints: Conform to contract 1.2 as published; contract gaps are recorded as open questions (design section 14, user-qa file), never as schema edits.
No raw secret or content value leaves the worker: masked_snippet only; every result string passes the Bureau Redactor; logs never print content, permission e-mails, file names or tokens.
Credentials only from env vars or files named by env vars; no committed credentials, keys or real tenant identifiers.
Every Go dependency pinned in go.mod/go.sum and vendored; stdlib preferred; no unpinned or latest versions.
Python code follows the python-coding-standards skill and typelint (no Any/object/dict/**kwargs, dataclasses/enums, no type: ignore); no touched file reaches 1000 lines.
Go code is gofmt-clean, go vet clean, explicitly typed, small packages, no package-level mutable state (the read-only embed FS in pytext/embed.go is the only package-level variable).
All verification is offline with fakes. Skip-only commands are not evidence, and non-test greps never contain the Python test-runner word.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Pull-mode Police worker over contract 1.2, because the Bureau never imports out-of-process code (design overview).

Rule detector ported with hand-written backtracking matchers and Python-generated pytext tables, never Go \b/\d/\w/\s/(?i), because RE2 and Go Unicode semantics differ from Python re (design 9.1-9.2).
x/text norm.Version must equal Python unidata 15.0.0; a mismatch is a Blocker, not a workaround (design 9.2).
Only 404 maps to gone; 410 is a fetch failure, by owner decision V1 on 2026-10-30.
Flagged finding fingerprints use a deterministic clean re-derivation (n = 1..16) so the Bureau Redactor never rejects a result (G4, V7).
Result body size guard moves the heaviest resources to failed to stay within 1 MiB (G3, V8); a pre-submit Redactor backstop fails the task with raw_value_guard (8.3).
Parity is proven by committed Python-generated fixtures plus a freshness test, and envelope goldens validated by a Python schema test (design 9.5, 10).
intentionalTradeoffs: V2: unsupported-type gdrive files are reported complete with exposure and no findings.

V3/G1: oversized content counts in resources_failed, which under unchanged Bureau rules costs the whole shard its complete_locators, exposures and inventories for that sweep (pending owner acceptance in user-qa).
V4: delegated root partition is paged with a worker cursor.
V5: Bureau network, 5xx and 429 errors back off instead of exiting.
V6: a scan_shard whose subject lookup fails counts all descriptor ids as failed.
V9-V11: location falls back to [REDACTED]; no owner/placement/modified_at; detect is bounded to 1000 files.
GDP-R5-L2: config lowercases domains with Go unicode.ToLower; gdrive applies the Python-exact CaseFold afterwards.
supportedEdgeCases: Gone, trashed, non-matching, permission-404, permission-error, oversize, invalid UTF-8, export-gone and rate-limited resources (design 7.2 table).
Delegated and non-delegated root partitions; user corpus without admin (sweep_unsupported); unknown corpus prefix (invalid_corpus).
Unicode digits, fullwidth input, dotted/dotless i and Kelvin sign under IGNORECASE, ligature expansions in normalization.
Sheets cells of int, float, bool, empty and ragged rows; titles containing quote, bang and spaces.
Heartbeat cancellation, handler panic, unknown task type, graceful stop, worker clock skew (task budget from deadline minus issued_at).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live Google Workspace tenants and real credentials.
Coverage or skipped reporting channels and multi-part results (future contract 1.3).
residualRisks: x/text norm.Version under go1.27.3 must equal Python 3.12 unidata 15.0.0 (gdp-p01, gdp-p05 report a Blocker otherwise).
Matcher parity for the 6 backtracking-sensitive rules depends on corpus breadth (at least 2000 seeded plus handpicked cases).
uvicorn serving the E2E harness app in the test loop, FakeClock leases and SQLite concurrency (gdp-p10 has the design-15 fallback and bounded waits).
GDP-R5-L1 (transient wave-2 compile coupling) and GDP-R5-L2 (domain lowercasing) are low residuals.
G1/V3 shard-wide degradation is pending owner acceptance; the E2E estate avoids it by construction.
